author: PosterSpy.com
title: Paid Wildwood posters for LAIKA
content:
✏️#Artists #illustrators

We've partnered with @BlackBearUK  for another amazing opportunity.  

@LAIKAStudios will select three PosterSpy members, each to create their own poster for Wildwood, celebrating the UK release on 23rd October.   

To apply for this paid commission, simply submit your PosterSpy portfolio for consideration (https://t.co/oiFpMLQhgI).   

Make sure your portfolio is up to date and showcasing your best work.  

⚠️ Apply before September 13th 11:59PM BST.   

You won't want to miss this one. Not a member? Sign up for free
